statement: A Summoning condition ("Cannot be Special Summoned", "Must be Special Summoned by ...", "Must be Special Summoned with ...") and what an Equip Spell can equip ("Equip only to ...") aren't treated as effects: negating the card's effects doesn't lift them, and nothing copies them (CONDITION).

sources.name: Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity
sources.says: Its "Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned ... by returning 3 monsters ..." isn't treated as an effect: it is how this monster is Special Summoned (効果として扱いません。このモンスターの特殊召喚の方法・手順です。). Gem-Knight Seraphinite's FAQ (card 10000, 0.5, 2024-11-23) says the same of "must first be Fusion Summoned", and Artmage Non-Finito's (0.5) of its Summoning condition (read by Claude, 2026-11-20, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

sources.name: Dark Energy
sources.says: "Equip only to a Fiend monster." isn't treated as an effect: it is the condition of the monster this card equips (効果として扱いません。このカードを装備するモンスターの条件です。). 16 Equip Spells' FAQs say the same.

scripts: The scripts give a Summoning condition (EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION) CANNOT_DISABLE and UNCOPYABLE, as RML does. aux.AddEquipProcedure gives EQUIP_LIMIT only CANNOT_DISABLE: an equip limit is never copied, so the missing UNCOPYABLE changes nothing.
